Outside these scans: shell and Python files other than deploy/**/*.sh (the local maintenance tools under tools/local, the contract checks, the acceptance and schema tests), files of deploy/** that are not *.sh or *.sql, and package files outside packages/*/src. Do not edit: run the generator; --check fails when it is stale.

reads[].at — path:line of the reading call ("#2" — the second place on the same line); reader — the reader kind: its rules for a missing row, NULL, "", a wrong JSON type and object merging are under readers; fallback — what this place passes (fallback_from: literal, the constant it names, wrapper, manual, seed, str() or caller — not known at this place); wrapper — the local helper that does the read; via — the key is computed at this place and the set of keys comes from fallbacks.manual.json; note — the place's own handling of the value.
seed — the value of the seed row (default_value after seeding); null — no default, the code's fallback applies. generic_reads — places that may read any key (batch checks, audit of a changed key).

{"$internal_value": "path:line", "sha256": …} — the value names one installation (its source is counted by the publication gate); it is kept only at that source, the digest of its canonical JSON ties the registry to it. The maintainers' snapshot tool builds the registry from the sources and uses the real value.

rule — the place's own post-processing of what its reader returns, in order (absent, null, type/else, int, integer (not an integer → its value), min, max, number, positive, int_clamp/else, int_in/else, in/else, eq, trim, edge_bound, out_of_range, unmodelled, min_of — Math.min with the value the same place computes for another key; "$fallback" — this place's fallback, "$default_value" — the row's default_value); edge_range — the EDGE_RANGES bound of the key (packages/shared/src/edge-settings.ts), functions not modelled are listed in unmodelled.

not_modelled — what the real reader of the place also depends on and the snapshot does not compute (another key, data, an argument): the snapshot shows the value without it, says so and keeps the place out of the claim that it equals the reader. condition — the condition of a SQL statement the scanner does not parse completely, pinned as text: its keys come from fallbacks.manual.json, a changed condition fails --check.

edge_meta — the name of the key in v_edge_export_settings (the names of edge_meta.settings; export_enabled stays inside) and the clamp every edge reader sees (sources.edge_meta_clamp: clampEdgeMeta — no value → default in its bound, out of bound → the bound; anchor bounds are runtime data and not modelled). The edge side (packages/edge-*/src, packages/bridge/src, contracts/schema/edge/*.sql) is scanned for every mention of such a name and every computed index of a settings object: each is a read (edge:meta — metaInt(), a reader of fallbacks.manual.json) or a skip with its reason there; an unclassified mention fails --check.
